parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 distinct high-potency human single-protein activity rows ordered by activity_id. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.organism is 'Homo sapiens', target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units is 'nM', standard_type is one of EC50/IC50/AC50, and standard_value is below 50. Return activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name aliased as target_name, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Use DISTINCT on the projection.
